reviewer: Codex root and independent AI implementation/review agents; human team review pending
observations: Exactly ten admin source/resource files; no user, database, POM, assets or wrapper changes.
Controller exposes GET and the three enumerated POST endpoints; auth/CSRF retain existing filter chain.
All three write Service entrypoints declare READ_COMMITTED and call AdminWriteGuard.lock before parent mapper access.
Parent product is locked before version/ownership validation; edit/remove lookup includes product_id and image_id.
Affected-row counts are checked for image writes and parent version CAS with Long.MAX_VALUE upper bound.
Valid normalized same-content edit returns before all DML and before version capacity rejection.
Runtime BusinessException rolls back the Spring transaction; forced rollback and concurrent interleavings remain STEP13.
Only album rows and product.version are explicitly written; cover, assets and historical snapshots are not updated.
Generated-key insert uses MySQL AUTO id and keyProperty image.id; no request-supplied entity binding.
400/409 form redisplay keeps failed raw values and submitted version; other forms read current version.
Thymeleaf escaped output; labels, error anchors, shared image and CSRF fragments; no nested forms or replace/if precedence conflict.
Additional CSS is scoped to A10; cross-app link base is trusted server configuration, not a request return URL.
verification_limits: Static review is separate from real build, HTTP/database and browser observations. See attempt results for executed coverage.
